patterns.note: High-contrast, vibrant color blocking is used extensively, primarily with lime green, hot pink, and black to define distinct sections and create visual energy.
Oversized, bold sans-serif typography is a core branding element, with the 'POTLUCK' logotype dominating the hero section and large headings used for strong visual impact.
The main navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid lime green background as it becomes sticky at the top of the viewport.
The hero image features a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls down the page.
A dark-themed newsletter signup bar slides up from the bottom of the viewport and remains sticky as the user scrolls, providing a persistent call to action.
Sections are structured using full-width, distinct color blocks that stack vertically, creating clear visual separation and a modular feel.

technique_notes: The site uses CSS keyframe animations to create a dynamic scrolling experience. The main navigation bar transitions its background color and height to become sticky, while the hero image employs a subtle parallax effect. Additionally, a newsletter signup bar is revealed with a slide-up animation from the bottom of the screen, becoming sticky on scroll.

Sections are defined by bold, full-bleed color blocks that provide high contrast for text and imagery. The brand's oversized logotype is integrated as a hero element, initially dominating the screen and then scrolling away to reveal content, maintaining a strong brand presence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (e.g., 'POTLUCK' logo is ~8-10x body text height) with clear hierarchy down to legible body and caption text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, especially in the hero and section breaks, with tighter spacing in content grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an extremely bold, oversized logotype as a primary design element that interacts with scroll, combined with a high-contrast, almost neon color palette (lime green, hot pink, black), creates a memorable and energetic brand identity that feels both modern and playful.
